answer: By the bridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The plume lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the marble is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
